# Support

For help with RavenEye:

- Open a discussion: https://github.com/devadarshmay-eng/RavenEye/discussions
- Report bugs: https://github.com/devadarshmay-eng/RavenEye/issues
- For Edge publishing pipeline failures, use the **Edge Store Regression** issue template.

Security-sensitive findings should not be posted publicly. Open a private security report via repository security advisories.
